description_en: A standalone triangular woven pouch with textile zip gusset and three leather attachment straps, no bicycle. Canonical front: a triangular woven face with three strap tabs. Side view: a narrow zipper gusset and attachment-loop thickness. Rear view: a second triangular woven face with padded frame-contact strips. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border.
